source: The file is the TorchScript checkpoint of Zenodo record 6861565 (CC-BY-4.0; cite Conrad and Narayan, Cell Systems 2023). It is cached in the folder the Model Zoo downloads into, ``~/.spacr/models`` unless ``dest`` names another, and a cached copy is used only when its sha256 is the published one. A download goes through :func:`fetch`, so it is checksummed and written atomically.
